name: m365-copilot-monorepo
description: Monorepo de M365 Copilot para VS Code: extensión de VS Code + extensión de navegador que capturan y sincronizan el token de Copilot.

scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rimraf node_modules releases
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm package:browser && pnpm package:vscode
scripts.package:browser: pnpm --filter m365-copilot-vscode-extension zip && pnpm --filter m365-copilot-vscode-extension zip:edge && pnpm --filter m365-copilot-vscode-extension zip:firefox
